title: Arriving Now: AI-Powered Toast Ordering on Google Maps
summary: New integration lets guests order directly from Toast restaurants through Google's Ask Maps feature, fueling discoverability for operators Toast (NYSE: TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today announced an expanded integration with Google that brings agentic food ordering to Ask Maps, a conversational AI feature within Google Maps. When a diner asks—by voice or text—for a restaurant recommendation or specific food request, Ask Maps can now put a Toast restaurant's menu directly in front of them and carry that request all the way through to a completed order. "At Toast, we're always looking for new ways to help our customers turn discovery into demand," said Kelly Esten, Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Operating Officer of Enterprise at Toast.
